$Comment: The warning before the Great Turkey charges: the Gobliterator's warning marker on the ground just ahead of it. Harvest_Feast_Template_Great_Turkey (NPC/Roles/Harvest_Feast/Templates) puts it on the Great Turkey as its wind-up starts, while it puffs up and gobbles. It carries no model effect, so the souls' pale sheen (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Glow) stays on it throughout. Duration covers the wind-up and the first moments of the charge; Scale and PositionOffset place the marker (Z ahead, Y down from its origin).
